info.title: Adaptive Factory Local Control API
info.description: Reviewed local-only M4 factory control and bounded M6 semantic validation contract. M5 execution remains separately contracted and disabled by default.

get.description: No bearer scope required. Returns local process liveness.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-ID
parameters.description: Optional bounded correlation identifier; omitted or invalid values are discarded and replaced with a generated UUID.

500.description: An unexpected internal failure was redacted and normalized.

get.description: No bearer scope required. Returns bounded database, schema, capacity and accounting readiness.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-ID
parameters.description: Optional bounded correlation identifier; omitted or invalid values are discarded and replaced with a generated UUID.

200.description: Database schema, capacity, and accounting invariants are ready.

500.description: An unexpected internal failure was redacted and normalized.

503.description: database unavailable or timed out, or schema, capacity, or accounting checks are not ready

post.description: Publishes one exact M5-bound semantic subject. Requires semantic:publish and a dedicated coordinator capability.

403.description: scope, kind, or repository denied

422.description: closed request invalid

get.description: Reads a bounded digest-verified semantic subject. Requires semantic:read and repository authority.

403.description: scope or repository denied

422.description: identifier invalid

post.description: Creates one immutable independent-validator assignment. Requires semantic:assign and the coordinator capability.

403.description: scope, kind, repository, or capability denied

422.description: closed request invalid

post.description: Atomically appends an assignment-bound finding and full-coverage bundle. Requires semantic:validate and the validator capability.

200.description: exact atomic evidence bundle or exact replay

403.description: scope, validator identity, repository, or capability denied

404.description: assignment or semantic subject not found

422.description: closed request invalid

post.description: Recomputes a deterministic verdict only from persisted canonical evidence and appends it. Requires semantic:adjudicate and the adjudicator capability.

200.description: exact deterministic verdict or exact replay

403.description: scope, kind, repository, or capability denied

404.description: semantic subject or complete evidence set not found

409.description: persisted evidence, verdict, or replay conflict

422.description: closed request invalid

get.description: Reads a digest-verified persisted semantic verdict. Requires semantic:read and repository authority.

403.description: scope or repository denied

422.description: identifier invalid
